text:
tara: Heads-up from monthly least-priv run: found a handful of broad KMS and project-level roles that look like historical cruft. starting a short coordination thread for SEC-5402 so we have evidence before any changes.

mike: paste list?

tara: redacted list below:
- serviceAccount:old-ingest@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com (roles/cloudkms.admin)
- user:contractor-kate@example.com (roles/editor)
- serviceAccount:legacy-reporter@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com (roles/editor)
- group:ops-legacy-admins@redwood.com (roles/cloudkms.admin)

ops-oncall: thanks — i can run checks after you post the log queries. prefer a staged approach, don't want to cause alert floods.

tara: commands i used to find them:
```bash
# snapshot project IAM bindings
gcloud projects get-iam-policy redwood-prod --format=json > /tmp/iam-snapshot-1822223333.json

# list bindings that mention KMS roles or editors
jq '.bindings[] | select(.role | test("cloudkms|editor"))' /tmp/iam-snapshot-1822223333.json
```

bryan: i'll run a last-use search in logs and cross-check scheduler runs. quick BigQuery to get last KMS calls by principal:
```sql
SELECT protoPayload.authenticationInfo.principalEmail AS principal,
       MAX(timestamp) AS last_call
FROM `redwood-logs.cloudaudit_googleapis_com_activity`
WHERE resource.type='cloud_kms_key'
  AND protoPayload.authenticationInfo.principalEmail IS NOT NULL
  AND timestamp >= TIMESTAMP_SUB(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), INTERVAL 365 DAY)
GROUP BY principal
ORDER BY last_call DESC
LIMIT 1000;
```

ops-oncall: plan suggestion: 1) collect owner and last_call evidence; 2) for principals with no activity > 90 days, do staged revocation: first change role -> roles/cloudkms.cryptoOperator (narrow), then after 48h convert to removal; 3) snapshot before/after to GCS and link SEC-5402.

hr-bot: note: contractor-kate has offboard date 2025-10-14 per HR roster. please route to HR liaison for confirmation before removal.

bryan: contractor-kate flagged. i'll attach HR note to SEC-5402. old-ingest SA last_call = 2024-09-11 (from logs) — looks stale. legacy-reporter last_call = 2026-01-03, looks active-ish.

tara: for ops-legacy-admins group i propose we do a membership prune + convert group binding to a narrowly scoped role on the keyrings they need. we should export membership with `gsuite-membership-export` and compare to oncall roster.

ops-oncall: revoke snippets (dry-run + commit):
```bash
# dry-run remove admin role for SA
gcloud projects remove-iam-policy-binding redwood-prod \
  --member='serviceAccount:old-ingest@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com' \
  --role='roles/cloudkms.admin' --format=json --dry-run

# commit (after snapshot)
gcloud projects get-iam-policy redwood-prod --format=json > /tmp/pre-iam-1822223333.json
gsutil cp /tmp/pre-iam-1822223333.json gs://redwood-audit/iam-snapshots/1822223333-pre.json

gcloud projects remove-iam-policy-binding redwood-prod \
  --member='serviceAccount:old-ingest@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com' \
  --role='roles/cloudkms.admin'

gcloud projects get-iam-policy redwood-prod --format=json > /tmp/post-iam-1822223333.json
gsutil cp /tmp/post-iam-1822223333.json gs://redwood-audit/iam-snapshots/1822223333-post.json
```

bryan: i'll attach BigQuery output and scheduler checks to SEC-5402 and mark old-ingest as approved for staged removal.

tara: also adding operational rollback: if any job fails referencing KMS keys after change, ops-oncall will reapply previous policy (post->pre delta stored) and open an incident labelled kms-entitlement-rollforward. we should also add a temporary alert mute to avoid paging noise while triage happens.

ops-oncall: agree. i'll schedule the staged change in next night's maintenance window (00:30-02:00 UTC) if owners and HR confirmation are attached.

audit-bot: snapshot saved: gs://redwood-audit/iam-snapshots/1822223333-pre.json ; enqueued log-export job audit-1822223333. ticket SEC-5402 created and linked.

tara: thanks all. i'll post updates in SEC-5402 and follow up in this thread once the maintenance change is scheduled. :white_check_mark:
